clue.text: Sound use should be found for such attractive ribbon

definitions.text: Sound use should be found for such attractive ribbon

parts.words: Sound use should be found for such attractive ribbon
parts.note: the ribbon is attractive in the physical sense, pulling on iron particles, and is used for recording sound

explanation.surface: A pretty ribbon ought to be put to some sensible purpose.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like 'sensible' and 'attractive' like 'pretty', but they mean audio and magnetised.
explanation.definitionFit: Recording tape is a long plastic strip coated with an iron oxide that holds sound as a magnetised pattern.

clue.text: Note the church raised nothing for a Continental place

parts.note: ME is a spelling of mi, the third note of the sol-fa scale
CH is the usual abbreviation for church

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising a word means reading it from the bottom up

parts.note: nil means nothing

explanation.surface: A church in Europe failed to collect anything in its appeal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns NIL into LIN beneath ME and CH.
explanation.definitionFit: Mechelen in Belgium, long famous for its lace, is known in English by this older form of its name.

clue.text: Understands about girl fliers being all at sea

indicators.note: the word for understands goes around the girl's name

parts.note: to get something is to understand it
Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Someone grasps that a girl's pilots are thoroughly confused.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all at sea' looks like 'confused', but it describes where these birds live.
explanation.definitionFit: Gannets are large seabirds that spend most of their lives far out over the ocean, diving for fish.

clue.text: A German princess making one cross?

explanation.surface: A royal woman from Germany is asked whether she annoys people.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition reads 'cross' as the mark a voter makes, so it is a woman who elects.
explanation.definitionFit: The wife of a German prince-elector held this title, and a woman voter puts a cross on her ballot.

clue.text: Extra sheets for particular people at home

parts.note: being in means being at home
a set is a particular group of people, as in the smart set

explanation.surface: Spare bedding is kept for certain guests staying in the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sheets' suggests bedding; it means pages.
explanation.definitionFit: An inset is an extra page or leaflet placed inside a magazine or book.

clue.text: Strike is interrupting those people giving remedial treatment

indicators.note: the word for strike breaks into the word for those people

parts.note: they means those people
a rap is a sharp blow

explanation.surface: Industrial action is disrupting the staff who give patients their care.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strike' suggests a walkout; it is a knock.
explanation.definitionFit: Therapy is treatment meant to heal or relieve an illness or disorder.

clue.text: Tip read out in "The Winter's Tale

indicators.note: out means put out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A useful tip is read aloud during a performance of Shakespeare's play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges TIPREAD.
explanation.definitionFit: Perdita is the lost princess raised by a shepherd in Shakespeare's late romance.

clue.text: In Australia a big figure is firm and sort of light reddish brown

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a big number
taken as written
CO is short for company, a firm
a Very light is a coloured flare fired from a pistol
bay is a reddish-brown colour, mainly of horses

explanation.surface: Somewhere in Australia a large statue stands solid and pale rusty brown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'light reddish brown' reads as one colour, but 'sort of light' is VERY and 'reddish brown' is BAY.
explanation.definitionFit: Discovery Bay is a wide bay on the coast of Victoria, near the South Australian border.

clue.text: Smoke in church and cause anger

explanation.surface: Lighting something in church makes people furious.
explanation.definitionFit: Incense is the fragrant smoke burnt at services, and to incense someone is to make them very angry.

clue.text: The director is a good man always with royalty

parts.note: ST, saint, stands for a good man
e'er is a poetic form of ever, always
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

explanation.surface: The boss is a decent fellow who always keeps company with the royals.
explanation.walkthrough: ER is the Queen's monogram, Elizabeth Regina.
explanation.definitionFit: A steerer is one who guides or directs the course of something.

clue.text: The enrolment of soldiers meaning to impose restrictions

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, is a corps of British soldiers
the gist is the general meaning
to ration is to restrict how much of something people get

explanation.surface: Signing up recruits is meant to limit who can join.
explanation.walkthrough: 'meaning to' reads as 'intending to'; 'meaning' is GIST and 'to impose restrictions' is RATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Registration is the formal entry of names on a list, as in signing up.

clue.text: Assemble for prayer

explanation.definitionFit: To collect is to gather together, and a collect is a short prayer set for a particular day in church.

clue.text: Using a comb to be deliberately irritating

explanation.surface: Combing one's hair just to annoy somebody.
explanation.definitionFit: Hair is teased by backcombing it into a full style, and teasing someone means needling them on purpose.

clue.text: The stunning beauty is a bit of a sloven usually

indicators.note: only a small stretch of the words sloven usually supplies the letters

explanation.surface: A gorgeous woman usually has something of the scruff about her.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'sloVEN USually'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman goddess of love is the classic type of female beauty.

clue.text: Lays ready all for changing into rather too soon

indicators.note: these letters change into a new order

explanation.surface: A singer has ballads prepared, all ready to switch at short notice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changing into' rearranges LAYSREADY.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying it is early days means it is too soon to judge how things will turn out.

clue.text: Bread scattered among the leftovers for a bird

indicators.note: the shuffled letters sit inside the word for leftovers

parts.note: the rest is what remains

indicators.note: crumbs scattered are thrown about, so these letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Crumbs are tossed among the scraps for a garden bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bread' and 'leftovers' set a scene of crumbs for birds, which hides the mechanics: 'scattered' shuffles and 'among' contains.
explanation.definitionFit: Robin redbreast is the familiar name of the robin, after its orange-red chest.

clue.text: Practised play

parts.note: reads as skilled sport, but means a stage piece that has been run through before the opening night

explanation.definitionFit: Actors go over a stage show again and again in practice runs before the public sees it.

clue.text: Both white and oriental coppers get rough

parts.note: hoar means greyish white, as in hoar frost
a sen is a small coin of Japan and other Asian countries

explanation.surface: White and Asian police officers alike turn violent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' suggests police; it means small coins.
explanation.definitionFit: To hoarsen is for a voice to become rough and husky.

clue.text: Take on when occupied with appeal

parts.note: at means busy with, as in at work
to tempt is to appeal to someone

explanation.surface: Accept a challenge while busy pleading.
explanation.definitionFit: To attempt something is to try or undertake it.

clue.text: Provide for a spiteful woman with some hesitation

parts.note: a cat is a spiteful, catty woman
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Supporting an unkind woman, but only after some dithering.
explanation.definitionFit: To cater for people is to supply what they need, especially food.

clue.text: Arrived on the building site to make a home for Arthur

parts.note: came means arrived
a lot is a plot of land for building

explanation.surface: Turning up on a plot of land to build a house for someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arthur' seems an ordinary man; it is the legendary king.
explanation.definitionFit: Camelot was the legendary court and castle of King Arthur.

clue.text: Drink and talk about right way to disable opponents

indicators.note: the drink and the talk go around the letter for right, which sits between them

parts.note: tea is a drink
gas is idle talk

explanation.surface: Having a drink and discussing the correct method to beat rivals.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphenated answer (4-3) hides that the right letter sits at the join of the two words.
explanation.definitionFit: Tear gas makes eyes stream so that rioters or enemies cannot fight on.

clue.text: Steal by arrangement, which is repulsive

indicators.note: by arrangement means these letters are set out afresh

explanation.surface: Theft by prior agreement is disgusting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrangement' rearranges STEALBY.
explanation.definitionFit: Beastly is an informal word for nasty or horrible.

clue.text: Get hitched? You would at one time, without approval

indicators.note: without means outside, so the old contraction goes around the word for approval

parts.note: ye'd is an old way to say you would
OK means approval

explanation.surface: Asked whether you would have married long ago, without anyone's blessing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside here, not lacking.
explanation.definitionFit: Animals yoked together are harnessed as a pair, as hitched to a cart.

clue.text: Defence force section

parts.note: to ram is to force in hard
a part is a section

explanation.surface: Part of a defence force.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads 'defence force' as one phrase; 'Defence' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A rampart is a defensive wall of earth or stone around a fort.

clue.text: A Moslem's face-saving contrivance

parts.note: face-saving usually means avoiding humiliation, but here it is a garment that literally covers the face

explanation.definitionFit: A yashmak is the veil worn by some Muslim women to hide the face in public.

clue.text: Brisk with everybody say backing gold

parts.note: all means everybody
eg, for example, means say

indicators.note: backing means the heraldic word for gold is read backwards

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: Lively because everyone, for instance, is supporting gold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns OR into RO.
explanation.definitionFit: Allegro is the musical direction for a quick, lively tempo.

clue.text: Power one perhaps tested as required

parts.note: a unit is a single thing, one

indicators.note: the letters are put into the order required

explanation.surface: A source of energy is checked when needed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'required' rearranges TESTEDAS into EDSTATES.
explanation.definitionFit: The USA is the world's leading superpower, a nation regarded as a world power.
